ax.set_ylim(0, 4.3)

                       boxstyle=f'round,pad={pad}', fc=fc, ec=ec,
                       lw=lw, ls=ls, alpha=alpha, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(b)
    if text:
        ax.text(x, y, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fs, fontweight=fw, color=tc, zorder=3)

def arrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, c=ARROW_CLR, lw=1.2, ms=10):
    a = FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2), arrowstyle='-|>',
                        mutation_scale=ms, lw=lw, color=c, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(a)

ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((0.05, 0.05), MID - 0.10, 4.10,
             boxstyle='round,pad=0.08', fc=C_ORANGE, alpha=0.04,
             ec='none', zorder=0))
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((MID + 0.05, 0.05), 6.75 - MID - 0.10, 4.10,
             boxstyle='round,pad=0.08', fc=C_DBLUE, alpha=0.04,
             ec='none', zorder=0))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  ROW 1 – Titles
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_DARK)
ax.text(RX, TY, '(b) OpenVLA  (MLP Projector)', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_DARK)

#  ROW 2 – Encoder boxes
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
EY = 3.65
BH = 0.30
rbox(LX, EY, 2.2, BH, 'SigLIP Encoder', fc=LIGHT_GRAY, fw='bold', fs=9.5)

        fontsize=8, color=MID_GRAY)
ax.text(RX, PY, '256 patches  (16×16)', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8, color=MID_GRAY)

arrow(RX - 0.60, EY - BH/2, RX - 0.15, PY + 0.07)
arrow(RX + 0.60, EY - BH/2, RX + 0.15, PY + 0.07)

CY = (CT + CB) / 2

        fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=C_VERMILLION, zorder=4)

# 4×4 coloured grid (input patches)
cs = 0.105          # cell size
gx0 = LX - 0.80    # grid left edge
gy0 = 2.82          # grid top-left corner (top-row top)

    for c in range(4):
        clr = warm4[(r + c) % 4]
        rect = plt.Rectangle((gx0 + c*cs, gy0 - (r+1)*cs), cs, cs,

        ax.add_patch(rect)

merged_cx = LX + 0.55
merged_cy = gy0 - 2*cs   # vertical centre of grid

            zorder=4)

# Merged token block

                              merged_s, merged_s, boxstyle='round,pad=0.03',
                              fc=C_ORANGE, ec=C_VERMILLION, lw=1.4, zorder=4)
ax.add_patch(merged_rect)
ax.text(merged_cx, merged_cy, '1\ntoken', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='white', zorder=5,
        linespacing=0.9)

# Small "×16" near merged block
ax.text(merged_cx + merged_s/2 + 0.06, merged_cy + 0.02, '×16',
        fontsize=7, color=C_VERMILLION, va='center', zorder=4)

ax.text(LX, CB - 0.02, 'spatially entangled', ha='center', va='top',
        fontsize=7, color=C_VERMILLION, fontweight='bold',
        bbox=dict(fc=C_ORANGE, alpha=0.12, ec='none', pad=1.5), zorder=4)

# --- Right connector outline ---

ax.text(RX, CT - 0.10, '2-Layer MLP Projector', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=C_DBLUE, zorder=4)

# 1:1 independent mapping
n_vis = 5
px0 = RX - 0.70    # input patch column
tx0 = RX + 0.45    # output token column
vy_top = 2.80
vsp = 0.14          # vertical spacing
cool5 = [C_SKY, C_DBLUE, C_GREEN, C_SKY, C_DBLUE]

    yy = vy_top - i * vsp

ax.text(tx0 + cs/2, vy_top + cs/2 + 0.04, 'token', ha='center', va='bottom',

arrow(LX, TKY - 0.07, LX, VY + VH/2)
arrow(RX, TKY - 0.07, RX, VY + VH/2)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  ROW 6 – LLM boxes

LY = 0.52
rbox(LX, LY, 2.2, BH, 'Qwen2-0.5B  LLM', fc=LIGHT_GRAY, fw='bold', fs=9.5)

arrow(RX, VY - VH/2, RX, LY + BH/2)

ax.text(RX, AY, '→  7-DoF Action', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8, color=MID_GRAY)
arrow(LX, LY - BH/2, LX, AY + 0.07, c=MID_GRAY, lw=1.0)
arrow(RX, LY - BH/2, RX, AY + 0.07, c=MID_GRAY, lw=1.0)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  Save
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515-2/projects/importance_margin_vla_compress/docs/paper/figures/paper/'
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

print(f'Saved: {out_path}')
print(f'Size : {sz:,} bytes')
